previous_assumption: assumed the inline respond-to-requirement form (radios plus Input/Select in one flex row, then appended after the whole table) was fine visually and UX-wise
correction: Two real problems, both client-reported: (1) Input/Select bake in their own mb-3 label-wrapper margin meant for vertical stacking -- used inline in a horizontal items-end row alongside plain radio labels and Buttons that lack that margin, items-end aligns the margin box not the visible content, so the radios/buttons hung 12px lower than the input boxes. (2) the form was appended once after the entire table regardless of which row's Respond was clicked, so with many open requirements it opened far below the fold, forcing a scroll to reach it. Fixed by replacing the inline Card with a Dialog (the same modal every other create/edit form in the app already uses) -- a modal is scroll-position-independent and its fields stack vertically, which is what Input/Select's mb-3 was already meant for, so the alignment problem disappears too rather than needing a margin-matching patch. Worth checking for the same items-end-plus-labeled-Input pattern anywhere else inline forms exist outside a Dialog.
